android-data-display|Card.summary: A Plenix card on Android is the Material 3 OutlinedCard, kept native in behavior (ripple, one TalkBack stop for a card that opens, font scale) and styled with the Plenix tokens: a 12 dp rounded rectangle on the raised surface with a 1 dp border and no elevation, a DM Sans semibold title at the heading role, a muted details line, and the Plenix selected border and accent edge. Material’s default is a filled, elevated or outlined card on a tonal surface with Roboto text; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.

variants.name: Card
variants.views: MaterialCardView with cardElevation 0, strokeWidth and strokeColor
variants.use: One record in a list or grid, with a title, details and actions.

variants.name: Interactive
variants.views: MaterialCardView with a click listener (isClickable, isFocusable)
variants.use: A card that opens its record; the whole card is one target and one TalkBack stop.

variants.name: Selectable
variants.compose: PlenixCard(…, selected = chosen, onClick = toggle) with Modifier.selectable semantics
variants.views: MaterialCardView isCheckable, isChecked, a checked strokeColor state list
variants.use: Choosing one or more options shown as cards.

variants.name: Media card
variants.compose: PlenixCard with an Image (ContentScale.Crop, aspectRatio(4f / 3f)) above the title
variants.views: MaterialCardView with a ShapeableImageView above the title
variants.use: An asset tile: a picture with its name and technical details.

variants.name: Accent
variants.views: A LayerDrawable foreground with a PlenixComponent.cardAccentBorderInlineStartWidth start bar
variants.use: A card that carries a color from the data, such as a project’s color.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.about: The rounded rectangle with its border; the whole card takes the press when it opens something.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.about: The card’s name, in DM Sans semibold at the heading role; a heading for TalkBack.

anatomy.name: Details
anatomy.about: An optional muted line under the title: counts, dates, owners.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.about: The content, at the body role.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.about: Optional Plenix buttons at the end of the header or below the body; each its own target.

anatomy.name: Accent edge
anatomy.about: An optional 3 dp bar at the start edge in a color from the data.

attributes.token: None: a Plenix card is flat; the border separates it

attributes.views: setContentPadding(p, p, p, p) with p = px(PlenixSpace.spaceContainerInsetMd)

attributes.value: 12 dp title to body (PlenixSpace.spaceStackMd), 16 dp body to actions (PlenixSpace.spaceStackLg)
attributes.views: Top margins of px(PlenixSpace.spaceStackMd) and px(PlenixSpace.spaceStackLg)

attributes.value: DM Sans semibold (600), 16 sp on 24 sp, Title medium (PlenixPlatform.textHeadingSize, textHeadingWeight)
DM Sans 14 sp on 20 sp, Body medium (PlenixPlatform.textSecondarySize), contentMuted
DM Sans 16 sp on 24 sp, Body large (PlenixPlatform.textBodySize), contentDefault

attributes.views: MaterialButtonGroup spacing, or margins of px(PlenixPlatform.buttonClusterGap)

attributes.value: 3 dp at the start edge, in a data color (PlenixColors.dataColorBlue …); mirrors in right-to-left layouts
attributes.compose: Modifier.drawWithContent { drawContent(); drawRect(accent, topLeft = Offset(if (layoutDirection == LayoutDirection.Rtl) size.width - PlenixComponent.cardAccentBorderInlineStartWidth.toPx() else 0f, 0f), size = Size(PlenixComponent.cardAccentBorderInlineStartWidth.toPx(), size.height)) }
attributes.views: foreground = LayerDrawable(arrayOf(ColorDrawable(accent))).apply { setLayerWidth(0, px(PlenixComponent.cardAccentBorderInlineStartWidth)); setLayerGravity(0, Gravity.START or Gravity.FILL_VERTICAL) }

states.compose: The ripple’s hover state layer; no elevation change

states.views: isChecked = true; setStrokeColor(ColorStateList) with android.R.attr.state_checked; checkedIcon = null
strokeColor state list with android.R.attr.state_focused, strokeWidth PlenixComponent.cardInteractiveOpenerFocusOutlineWidth while focused
